name: Starlink Group 10-39
slot_a_text: B1078 on its 30th flight. Perfect 29 for 29 on landings. Last flew Project Starfall Demonstration Mission 58 days ago. Targeting ASOG, 600 km downrange.
slot_b_text: B1078 has flown 29 times over 40 months. Its flights break down as 23 Starlink, one Crew, one O3b, and four others. Its quickest turnaround was 20 days. Only two cores in the fleet have flown more.
description: A batch of 29 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: The 'pogo oscillation' is a dangerous vibration caused by fuel surging in the pipes, which can shake a rocket to pieces.
